causal_rule: at snapshot date S, query each series with vintage_date=S and use only observations returned by that same ALFRED vintage; the latest returned observation may lag by more than one month and is carried as the actual information state available at S
rebase_policy: never stitch IPG3344S raw index levels across vintages; compute percentage changes entirely inside each single-vintage snapshot
lag_policy: for each series independently, compute 1/3/12-month comparisons against exact monthly lags from that series' latest observation within the same vintage; fail closed if required lags are absent
daily_join: equity consumer uses the latest snapshot with available_from <= signal calendar date
future_fill_policy: no later vintage may fill or revise an earlier snapshot row
next_boundary: a successful 139-row cache must be hashed and validated before the exact PR31/PR34 target-specific path-head consumer may run
